plan.screening: One complete same-input replay per version; screening is not independent speed certification
plan.confirmation: AB/BA/AB: full combination versus phase2 and best screened ablation
plan.abi_policy: All variants retain phase3 TraceSource layout; no-static/no-views remove use paths
plan.build_strategy: Copy immutable matching LTO archive, replace changed translation units, relink
plan.notes: FR-FCFS dense indices and FairEvent layout are coupled and ablated together; SPR selectors and sort keys are coupled as a group

labels.no-frfcfs: 撤销 FR-FCFS 紧凑数据/直接索引
labels.no-spr-hot: 撤销 SPR 热路径缓存/Sequencer 排序键
labels.no-static: 撤销静态查询缓存/记录内复用
labels.no-views: 恢复 vector 伴随数据调用
labels.sparse-clear: 仅清理触碰过的 FR-FCFS 索引

selection.rule: Highest single screened net rate; gains assessed only in fresh confirmation pairs

limitations: Only Zstd measured; no cross-workload generalization.
Three fresh pairs per comparison; not the 30-pair throughput acceptance.
Nonselected ablations have screening observations only.
LTO layout and optimization can change when a translation unit changes.
Fixed-core load snapshots do not exclude intervening competition.
Internal timers overlap and can cover warmup; not additive wall contributions.
No new native CPI/PMU accuracy or hardware certification.
